finding: Unavailable controls explicitly deny route execution but retain affirmative current-record and operation descriptions plus the later unconditional sentence that the selected operation executes once.
interpretation: Scorer correctly applies the availability-update oracle, but the prompt has competing affordance cues and an unconditional execution statement inconsistent with unavailable-action nonexecution. These failures cannot cleanly establish general task incapability or a refusal-ablation effect.
separate_limitation: Ordinary-faster competence also fails in every arm; this does not depend on the both-unavailable control.
recommended_action: Preserve the frozen main as unreleased. Any wording clarification must be a separate named diagnostic and cannot retroactively pass the old gate.
